caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of four various prompts (V1, V2, V3, and V4) of HDM in terms of humour, with the scores measured on the GEMBA-SQM scale. The categories (V1 to V4) are represented on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled with scores ranging from 60.0 to 80.0, marked at intervals of 2.5. The bars are colored distinctively: V1 is blue, V2 is orange, V3 is green, and V4 is purple. The bar heights represent the scores, with V1 scoring approximately 71.4, V2 scoring around 68.5, V3 scoring about 71.9, and V4 scoring roughly 68.15. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and they are arranged in a specific order from V1 to V4. V3 has the highest score at 71.9, while V4 has the lowest score at 68.15. None of the bars are visually emphasized.
